txt2img.name: Standard Quality
txt2img.description: High-quality text-to-image generation using KSampler. Best for detailed, photorealistic images.

txt2img-flash.name: SDXL Turbo Flash
txt2img-flash.description: Ultra-fast generation using SDXL Turbo with SamplerCustom. Ideal for logos, icons, and quick drafts.

img2img.name: Image-to-Image
img2img.description: Edit an existing image guided by a text prompt.

inpaint.name: Inpainting
inpaint.description: Fill masked regions of an image based on a text prompt.

outpaint.name: Outpainting
outpaint.description: Extend an image beyond its original boundaries.

upscale.name: Upscaling
upscale.description: Increase image resolution while preserving detail.

remove-bg.name: Remove Background
remove-bg.description: Remove the background from an image, returning an RGBA result with transparency.

txt2audio.name: Text-to-Audio (MusicGen)
txt2audio.description: Generate music and audio from a text description using MusicGen.

txt2video.name: Text-to-Video (Wan2.1)
txt2video.description: Generate short video clips from a text description using Wan2.1 T2V.
